name: @hara-lang/visual-language
description: Interface references, components, and public-site specimens for the Hara programming language

scripts.test: npm run assets:raster && node --test test/ui-package-boundary.test.mjs test/v2-catalogue.test.mjs test/v2-components-showcase.test.mjs test/v2-navigation-mobile-polish.test.mjs test/v2-catalogue-secondary-one-line.test.mjs test/v2-responsive-layout.test.mjs
scripts.site:dev: npm run assets:raster && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev --root site
scripts.site:build: npm run assets:raster && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --root site
